sentences.text: ORAL ORDER 1.

The present application is filed under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973, for regular bail in connection with FIR being C.R.NO.11201018210016 of 2021 registered with CID Cyber-Crime Police Station, Gandhinagar for offence under Sections 406, 420 and 120(B) of the Indian Penal Code and Section 43 of the Information Technology (Amendment) Act, 2008 and Section 66 of the Information Technology Act.
2. Learned Advocate appearing on behalf of the applicant submits that considering the nature of the offence, the applicant may be enlarged on regular bail by imposing suitable conditions.
3. Learned APP appearing on behalf of the respondent-State has opposed grant of regular bail looking to the nature and gravity of the offence.

She has submitted that as many as 787 ATM transactions had taken place at the behest of present applicant and sum of Rs. 77, 60, 300/- has been siphoned away NEUTRAL CITATION R/CR.MA/16440/2023 ORDER DATED: 19/10/2023 Jitendrakumar @ Monu Rambabu Katiyar vs State Of Gujarat on 19 October, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/79443671/

The modus operandi of the present applicant is such that he would insert some other object except the ATM Card in the ATM Machine and the machine would show the transaction failure, which was reported by the present applicant to the bank and the amount sought to be withdrawn was thereafter deposited in the account of the present applicant to the respective banks.
He, therefore, submitted to dismiss the present application.
4. I have heard the learned advocates appearing on behalf of the respective parties and perused the papers.
In present case, the investigation is over and charge-sheet has been filed.
The record indicates that the other co-accused viz. Manoj has been considered for grant of bail by the Coordinate Bench of this Court.

The role attributed to the present applicant is to the effect that the applicant used to visit various ATM centers of the various banks and tried to withdraw the amount from the ATM by inserting some other object except the ATM card, which the ATM machine would not accept and would show the transaction failure.

The present applicant used to report the transaction failure to the respective bank and the respective banks after verification used to deposit the amount of withdrawn into the account of the present applicant.

5. This Court has also taken into consideration the law laid down by the Hon'ble Apex Court in the case of Sanjay Chandra v. Central Bureau of Investigation, reported in [2012]1 SCC 40.
NEUTRAL CITATION R/CR.MA/16440/2023 ORDER DATED: 19/10/2023 undefined 6.

sentences.text: In the facts and circumstances of the case and considering the nature of the allegations made against the applicant in the FIR, without discussing the evidence in detail, prima facie, this Court is of the opinion that this is a fit case to exercise the discretion and enlarge the applicant on regular bail.
7. Hence, the present application is allowed.

sentences.text: ( f ) furnish the present address of his residence to the Investigating Officer and also to the Court at the time of execution of the bond and shall not change the residence without prior permission of Trial Court;
NEUTRAL CITATION R/CR.MA/16440/2023 ORDER DATED: 19/10/2023 undefined 8.
The authorities will release the applicant only if he is not required in connection with any other offence for the time being.
If breach of any of the above conditions is committed, the Sessions Judge concerned will be free to issue warrant or take appropriate action in the matter.
9. Bail bond to be executed before the lower Court having jurisdiction to try the case.
It will be open for the concerned Court to delete, modify and/or relax any of the above conditions, in accordance with law.
10. At the trial, the trial Court shall not be influenced by the observations of preliminary nature qua the evidence at this stage made by this Court while enlarging the applicant on bail.
11. Rule is made absolute to the aforesaid extent.
Direct service is permitted.

(M. R. MENGDEY,J) GIRISH Jitendrakumar @ Monu Rambabu Katiyar vs State Of Gujarat on 19 October, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/79443671/
